visual_inspection.observation: All11 pages visible in overview, covering comparison/recovery/thermal/electrical/assembly/requirements. Overview does not verify every annotation.
C1/R1/C2/C3 nominal/probe rows, supplied loaded masses and filled/hollow static-margin dots readable; criterion line and preliminary boundary present.
Backbone/loop/end topology labels and failed/unavailable states readable, arrowheads visible. Dense crossing connections require numbered edge legend to trace; no physical layout is established.
Source circuit node labels, separate recovery power branches, gauge/unavailable edge labels and arrowheads visible. Crossing lines require numbered source-net legend; no missing pins invented.

limits: Static offline selection states only, not browser runtime/interaction/FPS measurements.
No physical calculations, current temperature curves or fields, guessed pins or new inertia tensors.
Known extension triangle/cubic pattern only; unsupported patterns stop explicitly.
Contact sheet is an overview; representative full-size image observations are recorded separately.
Native elapsed time uses the existing warmed Swift module cache, not a fresh-machine or browser performance measurement.

runtime_dependency.note: This packet reuses the existing generated helper and warmed Swift module cache. A fresh checkout needs that small helper regenerated or retained; no separate renderer implementation is embedded.

graph_data_scope: All six supplied topology graphs, including the historical thermal graph available behind the UI toggle. The11drawings preserve default selections: current thermal interfaces, scalar history matrix, first assembly joint and source-selected first storyboard steps. They do not cover every toggle/joint state.
